findings: Successive first-maximum. select_stage2_subset ranks with the comparators select_detection already passes to std::max_element. For highest_confidence, a is less than b when a.score is lower, or the scores are equal and a.area_px is smaller. For largest_area, those keys are reversed. max_element replaces its champion only when the champion is strictly less than the next candidate, and when several elements are equivalent it returns the first. Repeat that selection up to the caller count on the candidates not yet chosen. admitted holds those winners in that rank order. One forward pass over the original vector appends every unchosen candidate to deferred, in candidate-list order. Each copied DetectionCandidate keeps its source_index. Stage2Admission holds the two vectors. An empty list returns both vectors empty, before max_element, because an empty range returns last. Any other strategy string throws std::invalid_argument.

A tie is comparator equivalence. Under highest_confidence, a later box with the same score and a larger area_px is strictly greater, so that larger box is the maximum. The earlier candidate wins, and the later one stays deferred, when both keys match: equal score and equal area_px for highest_confidence, or equal area_px and equal score for largest_area. The pose node passes a count of one, so that single first maximum is the pallet stage 2 estimates, and every later equivalent stays in deferred. A larger count admits the next successive first maxima, earlier before later among equivalents, and stops at the count.

The same rank comes from std::stable_sort, which preserves the relative order of equivalent elements. Sorting indices with the better-first form of the same comparator places those successive first maxima in a prefix of length min(count, n). Deferred is rebuilt by walking the original vector and skipping that prefix. std::partial_sort leaves the unselected range in an unspecified order. An indirect partial_sort of iterators matches the first-maximum rule when, once the strategy keys compare equal, the comparator orders the earlier iterator first. The sequential max_element loop is that rank at the count of one the pose node passes.

The node publishes the source_index fields of those two vectors. On a successful estimate it writes the admitted source index and the deferred source indices on PalletPoseStamped after input_depth_stamp. On estimate failure it publishes no PalletPoseStamped and writes the same two lists on the failure diagnostic, the only result that path publishes. The empty-candidate return and the depth-conversion return still publish nothing.
